name: Open WebUI
title: Private AI Chat Interface
description: Self-hosted ChatGPT-like interface for OpenAI-compatible APIs; add Anthropic, Google and others as connections in Admin Settings. All conversations stored locally with user management.

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Your OpenAI API key (optional if using other providers)

env.label: WebUI Secret Key
env.name: WEBUI_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Session/JWT signing key. Leave empty to have one generated and stored in the data dir.

env.label: Default User Role
env.name: DEFAULT_USER_ROLE
env.description: Role for new sign-ups (pending/user/admin); pending means an admin must approve them

note: Configure API keys for your preferred AI providers. All chat history stored locally. Create admin user on first visit.
